provenance.prompt:
Edit this exact 1536x1024 transparent RGBA Piper Quickstep 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet. Make only two localized pose changes: pose index 2 (top row, right cell) and pose index 4 (bottom row, middle cell). Preserve pose indices 0,1,3,5 exactly in content, position, identity, face, outfit, proportions, scale, direction, row/column and camera. Keep all six cells in place. Do not crop, shift, rescale the sheet, change its grid, add poses, or redraw any other pose.

Piper remains the same athletic adult human woman with warm brown skin, energetic face, bright orange high ponytail, russet-red uniform with cream speed stripes and trim, and matching red/cream trainers. Preserve complete human anatomy with exactly two arms/hands and two legs/shoes. Every figure faces image-right in the same three-quarter view.

Replace pose index 2 with a clearly distinct overhead load, not another version of pose index 1. Pose1 already shows both hands raised high above Piper’s head with her shoulders lifted. In pose2, lower both hands behind the crown to the upper back of her head, bend both elbows clearly outward, flex the knees deeper, and coil her torso as she gathers power before the overhead pass. Keep the hands separated and visible against the transparent background.

Replace pose index 4 with a clearly distinct post-release deceleration, not another extended-arm pose. Pose3 already shows both arms extended forward and upward at the release. In pose4, bring Piper’s torso more upright and shift her weight onto the lead foot. Let the lead arm remain high but begin bending at the elbow while the trailing arm drops diagonally toward shoulder height; her hands are open and empty. Pose5 remains the later balanced recovery with both arms lowered toward chest level.

The ball is always separate runtime art. Do not draw any ball, sphere, circle, dark oval, object, or prop in any cell. Keep all complete figures safely inside their original cells with transparent margins; no silhouette touches or crosses a cell boundary. Preserve true alpha-zero transparency and remove any low-alpha background glow. Return the edited transparent sheet only.

cleanup.method: per-cell largest alpha>=64 component; retain original antialias pixels within a2px dilation; remove alpha<8 and generated glow; uniform nearest-neighbor scale to <=330x330 and center in transparent512x512 cell; no pose rearrangement

review.notes: The attempt2 localized changes resolve both attempt1 pose-pair findings. Frame1 holds both hands high above the crown with a more upright torso; frame2 tucks the hands behind the crown, flares elbows and deepens the knee bend. Frame3 extends both arms forward/up; frame4 stands more upright with one arm bent high and the other dropping diagonally. Piper identity and complete two-arm/two-leg anatomy are consistent, no ball appears, alpha proofs are clean, and all six figures have >=91px margins on every side.

provenance.status: accepted source; eligible for atlas packing

separateBall.art: No basketball in source art; the separate runtime track releases on frame3/tick7 after source acceptance.

provenance.packaging: package-action6.py; 80x96 cells; baseline94; lossless WebP; 6 original pass-overhead poses

nativeReview.notes: Independent native review inspected all 12 per-frame captures at 100% and 120% in both facings. Frames 1–2 place the carried ball at Piper’s overhead hands; frame3 releases near the extended fingertips at tick7; frames4–5 continue the flight cleanly. All captures select production art; no visible clipping or body collision.
